summary.text: Named among the fifty-seven suitors from Dulichium in Apollodorus' catalogue — a homonym of Medon the herald of Odysseus' house on Ithaca in Homer.

story.text: Apollodorus counts Medon among the wooers assigned to Dulichium in the long island roll of Epitome 7.27, listed after Agerochus and before Agrius. Homer knows a different Medon — the house herald who warned Penelope of the suitors' plots (Odyssey 4.675–710; 16.395–430) — and does not name this Dulichian wooer.
